sheets.name: Summary
rows: RIVERKNOLL RENEWAL | RFP-STYLE CONCEPT COST PLAN
Decision brief • Rochester Institute of Technology • planning-level estimate in 2026 USD • not a bid, appropriation, or guaranteed System 3E price

Authorize measured site, building, tree, utility, hazardous-material and wildlife investigations; then issue a competitive RFP for architect + civil/MEP/structural/energy team and construction-manager preconstruction services. Require side-by-side System 3E and conventional bids on the same design, schedule, code path, envelope performance, and warranty terms.
Clustered phases; finish each courtyard once
CAPITAL RANGE BY TOTAL BED TARGET

At current Riverknoll rent assumptions, modeled gross revenue is $3,295,461 per year and modeled NOI is $1,977,276. That supports approximately $30,395,585 of 30-year debt at the illustrative financing assumption, versus total project uses of $221,652,423. The difference is a planning-level capital subsidy/equity gap before any capital grants, fundraising, or broader campus cross-subsidy. It is a warning to price affordability and funding together.
READ THIS BEFORE USING THE NUMBERS

The 513-bed target is the user-selected historic working baseline; RIT’s 2022 Campus Plan lists 444 Riverknoll beds. Enter verified capacity of retained 516–536 in Assumptions!B5 to reduce new-build area and cost. Until then, cost output conservatively prices all target beds as new. Cost rates, apartment area, demo, abatement, temporary enclosure, soft cost, contingency, escalation, occupancy, rents, operations and financing are editable planning allowances; obtain a measured survey, environmental reports and estimator/CM pricing before an investment decision. Units are unfurnished: fixed kitchen/bath fixtures and appliances are included in building cost; beds, couches and other resident-owned movable furniture are excluded. System 3E savings are not included in the base construction estimate; compare it through a same-scope performance RFP.

SENSITIVITY TO THE CONVENTIONAL WALL REFERENCE

The 14-to-1 wall-work and 5-to-3-month shell/core figures are stated by SYSTEM 3E USA for a 1,560 SF single-house example. The model does not treat them as total project duration. The energy estimate applies (1/R-conventional − 1/R-3E) × opaque wall area × Rochester degree-hours, then converts useful heat to gas input at the assumed efficiency and cooling to electricity at assumed COP. It excludes windows, roofs, floors, air leakage, thermal bridges, ventilation, domestic hot water, plug loads, heat recovery, actual RIT utility tariffs and any changes to HVAC design. Because 516–536 remains, enter its verified bed count before using project-wide savings.
